name: Bedside monitor
summary: A bedside patient monitor: ECG, pulse oximetry and breathing waveforms, vitals (HR, SpO2, resp, BP, temperature, QTc, pain, sedation), alarms and the drugs on board
help: Wire a Telemetry block (or a block's Live telemetry) in. Items on the channel (default vitals): hr, sys, dia, map, rr, spo2, temp, qtc, pain, rhythm, ectopy (share of ectopic beats), dropped (share of dropped beats), sedation, sedation_txt, nausea, airway, effects, alarms [..], who, day, drugs [..]. The waveforms are drawn in real time at the current rates; a long QTc moves the T wave.
